description: This file defines the PackingEvent interface which specifies methods and constants related to packing events within the Ofbiz framework, including event codes and methods for handling packing sessions and messages.

classes.name: PackingEvent
classes.description: An interface representing a packing event, including constants for event codes and methods for executing an event, receiving messages, and retrieving event status and code.

methods.name: runEvent
methods.description: Executes the packing event given a PackingSession and an event code.

methods.name: receiveMessage
methods.description: Returns a message related to the packing event.

methods.name: getEventStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the event as an integer.

methods.name: getEventCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code of the event.
